final_answer: To crush an empty soda can, you can either use a can crusher or a hammer and a nail. If you have access to a can crusher, simply place the can inside and turn the handle to compress the can. If you don't have a can crusher, you can use a hammer and a nail to crush the can by placing the nail on top of the can and hitting it with the hammer. However, be cautious as this can cause injury.
